# Bike Random Forest model and quality

```{r bike-random-forest}
set.seed(123)

bike_rf <- randomForest(
  cnt ~ .,
  data = bike_clean,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

bike_rf
```

```{r bike-model-quality}
bike_quality <- regression_metrics(
  actual = bike_clean$cnt,
  predicted = bike_rf$predicted
)

bike_quality$Model <- "Bike rental Random Forest"
bike_quality <- bike_quality[, c("Model", "RMSE", "MAE", "R2")]

kable(
  bike_quality,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Out-of-bag quality metrics for the bike rental Random Forest."
)
```
